text.p: Israeli troops shot and killed one Palestinian and wounded two others on Sunday in Haras village just west of Hebron in the West Bank, Palestinian sources said.
The Palestinian sources said an Israeli patrol entered Haras village and opened fire when Palestinians threw stones. They identified the dead man as Issam Akabneh, 18.
The army said it was checking the report.
The incident came as Israeli-Palestinian peacemaking remained in deep crisis over Israel's beginning a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem in March.

Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Sunday described as "a barbaric, shameful act" the stabbing to death of two Israeli women whose bodies were found in the West Bank on Friday. He said Israeli and Palestinian officers met to discuss the issue. Israeli police said they were investigating whether the killers were Palestinian guerrillas.
